items.title: Vercel Sandbox遭揭VerCellBreak問題，AI代理恐繞過網域限制外洩資料
items.summary: AI資安業者AIR Security近日揭露Vercel Sandbox的VerCellBreak安全問題。Vercel Sandbox是Vercel提供的隔離式程式碼執行環境，研究人員發現，攻擊者若控制沙箱內的AI代理，並能存取敏感資料，就可能繞過沙箱的網域允許清單限制，將資料傳送至未經核准的伺服器。

items.title: Windows Update憑證2027年到期，微軟提醒企業留意更新中斷風險
items.summary: 微軟近日提醒企業，用於Windows Update服務的部分憑證，將於2027年5月17日及6月19日到期。這些憑證用來驗證更新伺服器的身分，微軟已透過每月安全更新提供替代憑證，但若裝置未安裝必要更新，即使使用的Windows版本仍受支援，憑證到期後也可能無法繼續透過Windows Update取得安全修補及其他更新。

items.title: 微軟啟動PQC TLS憑證試行，檢驗伺服器身分驗證相容性
items.summary: 微軟近期說明後量子密碼學（PQC）TLS憑證試行計畫的進展。這項計畫於8月27日啟動，目的是測試採用抗量子數位簽章演算法的TLS憑證，能否用於既有系統的伺服器身分驗證。微軟也提醒企業，導入PQC憑證可能影響既有系統的相容性，應及早準備。

items.title: CSA推AI資安成熟度模型，協助企業因應高速自動化攻擊
items.summary: 雲端安全聯盟（CSA）發布Frontier Ready Assessment Framework，這套資安成熟度評估框架涵蓋3大面向、12類資安領域及5個成熟度等級，協助企業檢查現有資安防護是否足以應付頂尖AI可能加快網路攻擊速度、擴大攻擊規模所帶來的威脅，並規畫改善方向。

items.title: fix(ui): keep the Models page stable while it loads (#172608)
items.summary: fix(ui): keep the Models page stable while it loads (#172608) ## Problem Opening Models (`/settings/model-providers`) showed skeleton rows that kept reappearing, and the page height kept changing. After a provider sign-in finished, the whole page reloaded: skeletons again, plus usage and cost requests restarted. ## Solution - One initial loading boundary for the Models body. Loaded rows never return to skeletons. - `loaderPending` changes no longer reapply stale route data that cleared loaded content. - Background core refreshes no longer cancel and restart the independent usage and cost requests. - After a login finishes, only the connected provider's credentials refresh (`refresh(providerId)`). Usage, cost, catalog and other cards stay as they are. - The readiness summary and status regions reserve their space, and the settings shell reserves its header and sidebar-footer space before load. - While a provider's models are being checked, a small animated status is shown instead of text that toggles on and off. ## Evidence Measured in a real browser against a real Gateway built from this branch: | Measurement | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | Initial CLS, first 8 s | 0.0724 | 0.0041 | | Settings shell CLS on direct load | 0.0472 | 0 | | Page RPCs on open | 10 | 8 | | Page RPCs during a 40 s login | 17 | 4 | | Usage / cost RPCs during login | 5 / 3 | 0 / 0 | | Skeleton reappearance after load | yes | 0 | | Provider rows kept after login | — | 4/4 | ![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d54d1bd9-ecd4-45b7-8224-157005438a7a) ![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/924d89fe-b5a3-4ac8-8f91-336783985c78) Tests: the Models page controller, view and login suites (100 tests), including "after a successful login only provider X refreshes; existing rows do not return to loading" and the settings shell layout traits. ### Review follow-up (`81c614724b`) - When a login finishes, one shared catalog reconcile runs (`models.authStatus` once, then `models.list` once). Invalidations that arrived during the login are merged into that read, so newly available models appear without a manual Refresh. Usage and cost requests are not restarted. - If the targeted status refresh fails after the credentials were saved, the existing rows stay and the page shows "Sign-in saved, but refreshing status failed. Retry", with a retry for that provider only. - Fixed the test-type errors (TS2698 / TS18046) with typed fixtures. Real Gateway, real Muse Code sign-in: ``` before: default Model picker disabled; no usable chat model after: default Model picker enabled; Meta row shows 4 models existing provider rows retained: 1/1 (same DOM node) skeleton reappearances during login: 0 login completion models.authStatus requests: 1 login completion models.list requests: 1 usage.status / sessions.usage requests during login: 0 / 0 active model unchanged ``` The WebKit `session-hovercard-automations.browser.test.tsx` failure in the earlier run does not reproduce: same macOS runner, origin/main `f8e52977e06` PASS 3/3 and this branch PASS 3/3. This PR does not touch that test or its owners. ### Review follow-up 2 (`92fcef963f6`) - **Deferred invalidations are applied when the picker closes.** Credential invalidations that arrive while Connect provider is open are kept. Closing, cancelling or completing the login then reconciles credentials, without restarting usage or cost. - **Refresh by credential owner, not display brand.** A selected choice carries `capability.provider`, so a brand like `example` refreshes its `example-owner` credentials. The existing alias fixture covers this. - **i18n / lint.** The source copy scanners now classify `.test-support.ts(x)` as test files. The raw-copy baseline was regenerated through the documented flow. **Linux WebKit `session-hovercard-automations.browser.test.tsx`:** not caused by this PR. The same failure (line 86: expected ``, got the automation ``) appears on unrelated PRs: [#171301](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38652781026/job/116155820482) (before this PR's failure), [#171625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38654938998/job/116162907110), [#172543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38656531959/job/116168108835). The test mounts the hovercard directly and does not load the Settings layout this PR changes. ## Update behavior UI only. No config or protocol change. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: feat(agents): remember native runtime consent per agent (#172607)
items.summary: feat(agents): remember native runtime consent per agent (#172607) ## Problem Every new chat that used a host-native runtime such as Muse Code asked again: "Use Muse Code's native permissions?" The owner wants to approve this once and not see it again. ## Solution - New agent-scoped config `agents.entries..nativeRuntimeConsent: string[]` (harness IDs). Helpers live in `src/config/native-runtime-consent.ts`. - Core evaluates the list at every turn (`assertAgentHarnessExecutionEnvironment`). The usual gates still apply: current session identity, Full Access, sandbox off, no tool allowlist, no `disableTools`, no swarm collector. Required sandbox or workspace-only restrictions still refuse. Remembered consent is never copied onto the session, so removing a harness from the list revokes it on the next turn. - When an admin selects a remembered harness (model selection or `sessions.create`), the session is raised to Full Access with sandbox off. Only admins: non-admin callers keep today's refusal. - In chat, a remembered harness recovers silently. Other harnesses still get the existing two-choice prompt. - Revoke from Settings → config: "Remembered native runtime permissions". - Schema, help/labels, docs (`docs/gateway/config-agents/entries-and-multi-agent.md`) and the generated config baseline are updated. The key is new and optional, so no migration. ## Evidence Live run on an isolated Gateway (real `muse` 1.3.0, real Meta sign-in): - With `muse` remembered for `main`, a second new chat with Muse Spark 1.3 replied with no permissions prompt (screenshot). - After removing `muse` from the list in Settings, the next new chat showed the prompt again. `chat.send` over RPC to an unconsented session returned `INVALID_REQUEST`, and `chat.history` stayed empty. ![second chat, no prompt](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c5bb9fb-f6b8-49ed-9508-55ac998b5670) Tests: `execution-environment.worker.test.ts` (remembered consent admits; removal refuses with no session patch; forbidden states refuse), `sessions-patch-native-recovery.test.ts`, `sessions-create.native-consent.test.ts` (admin, non-admin, and admin without a profile-bound authority), `chat-model-restriction-recovery.test.ts`. Note: the `check:max-lines-ratchet` env-name budget reports 455 > 454 on this branch. This branch adds no `OPENCLAW_*` names (added and removed sets are empty), so the overage comes from main. ### Review follow-up (`79e67a17ffa`, rebased on main) - **Implicit promotion uses the permission owners.** A model-only `sessions.patch` or a `sessions.create` that promotes to Full/sandbox-off goes through the same sandbox validator and permission-change preparation/acknowledgement as an explicit `permissionMode` patch, so an active run refuses it the same way. - **Revocation before native I/O.** Right before native `runAttempt`, core rechecks admission against the live config (`readRuntimeConfig()`), not the prepared snapshot. - **Provenance (b46c38cfa732).** That commit set up runtime-selection preparation inside the existing session mutation lane, keeping worker-placement validation, commit-time authority checks and the post-commit queued-selection refresh. This change keeps those owners and sends implicit permission promotions through the existing containment and permission lifecycle, instead of treating them as plain model-field assignments. Live proof: isolated Gateway on this head, real `muse` 1.3.0, `tools.profile=full`, `tools.deny=["browser"]`. `main` remembers `muse`; `other` does not. With no OpenClaw restriction, Muse may run without consent by design; consent is only required when OpenClaw has a restriction Muse cannot enforce. 1. Non-admin caller is refused: ```text connect granted: role=operator scopes=[operator.read, operator.write] sessions.create(model=meta/muse-spark-1.3): agentRuntimeOverride=muse; permissionMode/sandboxMode unset (no promotion) chat.send -> INVALID_REQUEST code=AGENT_RUNTIME_RESTRICTED reason=tool-policy "Muse Code uses its own tools and cannot enforce this chat's OpenClaw tool restrictions." sessions.patch(model=meta/muse-spark-1.3) -> same restriction; chat.send -> same restriction chat.history: messages=[] ; native turn/start count unchanged (9) ``` 2. An agent without the consent entry is refused: ```text connect granted operator.admin/read/write; agent:other: sessions.create(model=meta/muse-spark-1.3): no permission promotion chat.send -> INVALID_REQUEST code=AGENT_RUNTIME_RESTRICTED reason=tool-policy recovery.action=use-native-permissions chat.history: messages=[] ; native turn/start count unchanged (9) ``` 3. Revocation stops already-queued work: ```text sessions.create: permissionMode=full sandboxMode=off 00:22:01.543Z first native dispatch: turn/start count 8 -> 9 00:22:01.565Z second chat.send accepted; queueDepth=2 sessionState=processing 00:22:02.190Z config.patch nativeRuntimeConsent=[] 00:22:40.343Z first turn completed 00:22:40.427Z queued drain refused: "Muse Code cannot run with this chat's tool restrictions." 00:23:12.193Z native turn/start count still 9 (no second Muse turn) ``` 4. Upgrade cell: state written by the previous main build `962375d5ee` loads on this head; `config validate` passes; config SHA-256 is unchanged before and after (`47d3347e…e301`). ## Update behavior The key is additive and optional. Existing configs load unchanged; with no key, behavior matches today's per-chat prompt. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
